name: The Founder Sphinxes
description: Five elder sphinxes, formed from harmonious mana, who founded Hexhaven Academy and now act as aloof deans.

timeline.summary: Harmonious mana on the Theorist's Arcavios creates five elder sphinxes and unified schools.
timeline.quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes and inspiring schools that held unified perspectives.

timeline.summary: The sphinxes found Hexhaven Academy atop the leyline confluence to teach and protect the people of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: Hexhaven Academy was built on top of the large leyline confluence from which the sphinxes had emerged.
